about: What an ETF must show before it may enter the Indian equity study. Every criterion passes, fails, or is unresolved (not enough evidence yet). An ETF is ELIGIBLE only when every criterion passes. Thresholds marked proposed are data-quality defaults awaiting the user's approval; the liquidity threshold is left unset on purpose.

categories.nifty50: AMFI scheme name names the Nifty 50 index (not Next 50, not a factor or equal-weight variant, not an index fund or fund of funds)
categories.niftynext50: AMFI scheme name names the Nifty Next 50 index
categories.bank: AMFI scheme name names the Nifty Bank index (not PSU, private, top-10 or other bank indices)

window.end_note: null means the last observed session of the venue

venue_note: The NSE archive refused connections on 2026-10-28, so BSE is the only venue with reachable history. BSE ETF volumes are far smaller than NSE's; liquidity measured on BSE does not describe NSE.

execution.note: A separate execution constraint, not an eligibility criterion: a simulated order larger than this share of the ETF's verified traded value that day is unfilled (india/execution.py). A day without a valid file, including a documented data gap, fills nothing.

capital_note: Simulated capital. An ETF whose single unit cost more than this on an observed day cannot be bought whole on that day.

min_presence.note: share of the venue's observed sessions in the window on which the ETF has a row (traded)

break_ratio.note: a close-to-close change beyond this factor between adjacent sessions is treated as a possible corporate action, not a market move

distributions.rule: the ETF's distribution (dividend / IDCW) history for the whole window is reviewed against official documents and recorded as a verified 'distributions-reviewed' entry in corporate_actions.json
distributions.status: added by Claude in Phase 2.2 for the user's review: the user's rule is that no ETF is eligible while corporate-action evidence is unresolved, and a distribution lowers the price without a break, so price files cannot show that none occurred

liquidity.status: provisional; approved by the user on 2026-10-28 (Phase 2.1 review). Do not change without the user's approval.
liquidity.note: median daily traded value on the venue, sessions without trades counted as zero from the first observed day; the threshold has not been chosen
liquidity.rationale: Proposed: the largest simulated order (the whole INR 3,000) should be at most 1 percent of a typical day's traded value, so that the study's own orders are a negligible share of the market they assume they can trade in. 3,000 / 0.01 = 300,000. See etf.py liquidity for the consequences of this and other thresholds.
